FDA posts the midazolam hydrochloride shortage

explanation.headline: FDA's records trace our supply to plants with OAI classifications and a Warning Letter within 8 days of the shortage posting

sentences.text: FDA first posted the midazolam hydrochloride shortage on 2020-04-02 and it remains current as of 2026-10-21.
The shortage posting lists Hospira, Inc. and Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc. among the affected manufacturers.
Hospira's plant (FEI 1925262) received an OAI classification after an inspection ending 2018-08-15, 596 days before the shortage posting.
Pfizer Healthcare India Private Limited (FEI 3008316085) received an OAI classification after an inspection ending 2019-09-06, 209 days before the shortage posting.
A Warning Letter was issued to Pfizer Healthcare India Private Limited on 2020-03-25, 8 days before the shortage posting.
Hospira's plant (FEI 1925262) received another OAI classification letter dated 2020-04-22, 20 days after the shortage posting.
The rule-based best option is to buy from A-S Medication Solutions, which is not on FDA's shortage list today.

Q-82ecb3.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%midazolam%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%midazolam%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-e91c2c.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%midazolam%' ORDER BY first_posting
